prose: In the 2016 election to the 140-seat Kerala Legislative Assembly, the Left Democratic Front (LDF) emerged largest with 91 seats, against 47 for the UDF and 1 for the NDA (1 to others/independents). Turnout was 77.59% of 26,081,762 electors.
By vote share, the LDF polled 44.6% and the UDF 35.64%, with the NDA on 14.56%. A total of 1,203 candidates contested the 140 seats.
Compared with 2011, the LDF gained 23 seats (from 68 to 91); the UDF moved from 72 to 47. Power changed hands from the UDF.
The closest contest was Wadakkanchery, won by Anil Akkara (INC) over Mary Thomas (CPIM) by just 43 votes. The largest margin was P. J. Joseph in Thodupuzha (45,587 votes).
Pinarayi Vijayan headed the Council of Ministers that followed.
